verdict.rationale: Plugins are a fair axis for a note-taking app, but the evidence shows no in-app plugin or extension system, extension SDK, or plugin samples. The documented REST API (OAuth2/PKCE, OpenAPI spec on openpm) only appends data and lists bookmarks for external clients, which is an adjacent integration capability rather than a plugin API. Community comments describe Reflect as working without plugins, which is consistent with this absence.
